id: title:adboio:smooth sidebar transitions and bound tab memory

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop product command menu and shortcuts sheet state management, potentially affecting command assignment and display.
review.reason: The chunk represents a cohesive UI refactor for the Desktop product. P1.F5.H3 and P1.F7.H4 show a change in loading strategy for review pages, replacing inline lazy-loading with a preload helper. P1.F8.H1 and P1.F8.H2 demonstrate a removal of internal React hooks and replacement with prop-driven state management for task and visual task order. This is a substantive, bounded change:
review.uncertainty: The actual performance benefit of the preload helper and the complete behavioral change of the command menu are not demonstrated by execution or test results in the provided observations. The connection to PostHog's broader reliability or security posture is not established, though it could improve perceived performance and reduce bundle size. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces inline lazy-loading with a preload helper; the ReviewPage and CloudReviewPage are no longer loaded immediately, but their loading is triggered by a preload call.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces initial bundle size and avoids unnecessary rendering of review-related components until the user actually requests them, while still allowing the review page to be loaded when needed.

observations.behavior: Adds a preload call to the RightPanel component, which triggers the loading of review pages before they are needed.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows review pages to be loaded in advance, potentially improving perceived performance when the review page is accessed.
